passenger_response.subject: Update on booking AER-7T3M1B
passenger_response.body:
Dear Chidi Okonkwo,

Our record shows that flight AK220 on 2026-08-05 was cancelled because a hydraulic system fault was identified during the pre-flight inspection. The aircraft was withdrawn from service and no replacement airframe was available at the station.

The rebooking requests for Chidi, Adaeze and Emeka, including travel to Rome by Friday evening, 7 August 2026, need a colleague to review. The handover has not been completed; no decision has been made.

Ngozi’s rebooking request, including transfer of her booked wheelchair assistance and review of the available options before she decides, needs a colleague to review. The handover has not been completed; no decision has been made.

Tobias Achebe’s refund request needs a colleague to review. The handover has not been completed; no decision has been made.

The request for assistance after waiting at Manchester Airport since 5 a.m., including a drink and directions, needs a colleague to review. The handover has not been completed; no decision has been made.

Care is owed because the flight was cancelled. This includes meals and refreshments up to GBP 30 per passenger per 6 hours, two calls or equivalent, a hotel up to GBP 180 per room per night for a maximum of 3 nights, subject to station allocation, and transport up to GBP 45 per journey.

Compensation cannot be assessed until re-routing, or refusal of re-routing, is settled and the passengers have actually travelled, because the arrival delay at the final destination is not yet known.

Kind regards
